title: The Bow
notes: Strong chapter: the bow-as-covenant thesis is driven hard with dense scripture chaining from Noah through Babel, Elam, Hosea, and the two names. The qesheth/toxon/rainbow/deceitful-bow assembly is clear and law-positive. Issues are mostly house-style: multiple author sentences open with And/But/That, residual presenter cues (See, Notice, look what), one missing parallel verb, and a parenthetical that hedges by naming a debate the book leaves open. Surgical opener and cue cuts will tighten the voice without touching doctrine or quoted text.

proposals.old: God makes this first covenant __“between me and you and every sym:sym-living[living creature] of all flesh”__ (Genesis 9:15) — and in the language of these symbols a living creature is a nation: the sym:sym-beast[beasts] of Daniel’s sym:sym-sea[sea] are kingdoms, the living creatures of Revelation peoples.
proposals.new: God makes this first covenant __“between me and you and every sym:sym-living[living creature] of all flesh”__ (Genesis 9:15) — and in the language of these symbols a living creature is a nation: the sym:sym-beast[beasts] of Daniel’s sym:sym-sea[sea] are kingdoms, the living creatures of Revelation are peoples.
proposals.rationale: The clause drops its verb after the colon; "are kingdoms" requires the matching "are peoples" for parallel structure.

proposals.old: But the Hebrew names it plainly: it is a _qesheth_, a *bow* — the same word used everywhere else for the warrior’s weapon.
proposals.new: The Hebrew names it plainly: it is a _qesheth_, a *bow* — the same word used everywhere else for the warrior’s weapon.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author-prose sentences that open with But.

proposals.summary: Replace the director cue with an assertion.
proposals.rationale: "See its reach" is presenter staging; house style bars such cues and prefers a direct claim.
House style forbids author-prose sentences that open with That.

proposals.old: (Whether this rider is the true King binding the nations to Himself or a counterfeit binding them to a lie is a question this book leaves open; either way, the instrument of conquest is a covenant.)
proposals.new: (True King or counterfeit, the instrument of conquest is a covenant.)
proposals.summary: Cut the meta-talk that leaves a debate open.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids hedging and naming debates for the reader to weigh; keep the symbol point without the aside.

proposals.old: And when God draws, look what fills His hand: __“I have *bent Judah* for me, *filled the bow with* sym:sym-ephraim[Ephraim]”__ (Zechariah 9:13) — the covenant is the weapon, and the covenant people are its string and its arrows.
proposals.new: When God draws, His hand is filled: __“I have *bent Judah* for me, *filled the bow with* sym:sym-ephraim[Ephraim]”__ (Zechariah 9:13) — the covenant is the weapon, and the covenant people are its string and its arrows.
proposals.summary: Drop And and the director "look what."
proposals.rationale: Fixes a sentence-open And and removes presenter staging in the same line.

proposals.old: And God answers in kind: He does not topple the tower, He cuts the bond.
proposals.new: God answers in kind: He does not topple the tower, He cuts the bond.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author-prose sentences that open with And.

proposals.old: Notice what the sign is made of.
proposals.summary: Replace the forbidden Notice cue with an assertion.
proposals.rationale: "Notice what" is a director cue barred by house style; assert the claim instead of staging it.
